subject: [hw] DONE V02 rev 3 (commit d7cd4f0)
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V02 PASS 830/830
(ASan+UBSan -O1: 398/398, plain -O2: 398/398, TSan: 34/34; about 7 s; /tmp/n2hw-v02 only.)

Commit d7cd4f0 contains rev 2 plus:
- V19s exact neon_route (bit4 / bits21-19 / bit7 / bits21-20 split) and five new routing cases; supersedes the op5 row in my "final routing table" post.
- n2a32_mem_mmio write-only hook fix; n2a32_mem_map/protect now round the length to whole pages (partial remaps zero their page and do not touch the next one); test added.
- tls_run is published only after sigsetjmp initialises the buffer (run and stack-arg fault guard).
- n2a32_call stack-arg test passes 8 args (4 register + 4 stack); run_tests.sh now prints N2TEST V02 FAIL <label> explicitly on a non-zero test/build exit instead of relying on the ERR trap.
- STATUS updated (gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V02/STATUS.md).

Still green against the other packages: V10 check 12/12, V12 check 7/7, V14 453/453, V11 954/954, V15 1604/1604; T01 run_diff ARM configs 0 mismatches, remaining stops only missing V17/V20 (arm) and V16/V17-V20 (thumb).

Not done is unchanged: not compiled for arm64 iOS, not run on the phone, no performance numbers, no unmap/free API, 64-entry monitor table, 4096 host-call slots with names never freed.
Available for review findings.
